# OpenFreeMap Positron style

`cart/tracking-map-style.json` is the Positron style downloaded from https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron on 21 September 2026, with only a descriptive `name` added and JSON minified. The original style colors and layers are preserved. Ezkart adds its shipment markers and route at runtime.

Upstream: https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles (MIT); based on https://github.com/openmaptiles/positron-gl-style (BSD-3-Clause code, CC-BY-4.0 design), derived from CartoDB Basemaps by Stamen and Paul Norman for CartoDB Inc. (CC-BY-3.0). License notices are included here and accessible from the map attribution.

Tiles, sprites, and fonts are served by OpenFreeMap; OpenMapTiles/OpenStreetMap attribution supplied by the tile source remains visible. No CARTO or MapTiler hosted API is used.
